title: The Election
article:
As many of you know, Donald Trump was just elected President of the United States of America along with his running mate and future vice president JD Vance. This election was one of the most eventful elections in history between Biden dropping out about 100 days before the election and Trump's assassination attempt. Trump won with a whopping 312 electoral college votes versus Kamals’s 226 electoral votes. Trump won all seven swing states (Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Michigan, Georgia, Nevada, and Arizona). In the 2020 election the democrats won most of those swing states (Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Michigan, Georgia, and Nevada.) In addition, Trump won 50.1% of the popular vote versus Kamala’s 48.3% of the popular vote. Some might call this victory a landslide and others might call this a close race. Really it is up to you to form your own opinions.





A cabinet is a group of people that the President selects to help him run the country. Trump has to choose many people for many roles. Trump also created a government system called the “Department of Government Efficiency.” He nominated Vivek Ramaswmay and Elon Musk to lead it. For the Department of Health Trump chose Robert F Kennedy who was originally supposed to be on the presidential ballot but dropped out because he knew that he wasn’t going to win, then endorsed Trump supposedly helping him win. Trump picked Lee Zeldin, a former New York congressman, as the ambassador to the EPA. Trump picked Tom Homan as “Border Czar”, Elise Stefanik as U.N ambassador,

Some of Trump’s promises are to secure our border, to lower crime, to reduce inflation, turn the United States of America into a manufacturing superpower, make our college campuses safe, and large tax cuts on workers. According to the budget committee, during Biden’s term, 8 million unauthorized migrants entered the US, and 6.7 through our southern border. Under Biden the inflation rate increased by 5.2% a year, the 3rd most in American history. Meanwhile Trump's inflation rate increase per year was 1.9%. Trump says he wants to turn our country into a manufacturing superpower. As of right now we get 16.5% of our imports from China but we import the most from Mexico which is the first time in two decades that that has been the case. The United States leads the world by crude oil production by producing roughly 13 million barrels a day. Trump wants to increase this amount by reopening the Alaska pipeline which in turn would increase the amount of oil we drill out of Alaska. There has been a lot of controversy over this though by people saying that it would destroy the natural environment where they will be drilling. As many of you know since October 7th took place antisemitism and anti semitic related assaults have been up especially on our nation's campuses. Trump claims he will make college campuses safe and prevent attacks from ever happening. Trump is proposing to make a large tax cut for the working people of America to make sure that everyone has enough money to live comfortably. These are ideas he has put forth, some of which might happen and some of it won’t. So, it is up to you to form your own opinions about Trump’s agenda.
